title: Finite affine chart cover
statement:
If $I=(f_0,\ldots,f_r)$, the affine opens

$$
\operatorname{Spec}(A[I/f_i])
$$

form a finite open cover of
$\operatorname{Bl}_I(\operatorname{Spec}A)$.

proof.text:
The opens $D_+(f_it)$ cover by
[lemma-nagata-rees-generators-cover-proj]. Replace each one by the
affine spectrum supplied by [prop-nagata-affine-blowup-chart]. The
compatibility of the open embeddings with the structure map is part of that
chart isomorphism.

lean.statement:
lemma _root_.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineBlowup.iSup_basicOpen_reesX_eq_top_of_span
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A]
    {I : Ideal A} {s : Finset A} (hs : Ideal.span (s : Set A) = I) :
    ⨆ a : s, Proj.basicOpen (reesGrading I)
      (reesX I a.1 (hs ▸ Ideal.subset_span a.2)) = ⊤
lean.note: Interface repair under §1(B): the old iSup_opensRange_blowupι_eq_top indexes the affine opens of the BASE scheme and does not state the finite generator chart cover of this node. The existing iSup_basicOpen_reesX_eq_top_of_span instead gives exactly the cover indexed by any finite generating set of I. The imported chart is an open immersion with opensRange_chart equal to that basic open. Its source is Spec of the homogeneous degree-zero localization; the existing homogeneousAwayEquivChart in WeilConjectures.Blowup.Affine.ChartAlgebra canonically identifies this ring with A[I/a], as recorded by def-nagata-blowup-chart-ring. Finite repeated lists reduce to their finite range. No new theorem or definition is introduced.

blueprint_update.statement:
Let $A$ be a ring and let $I=(f_0,\ldots,f_r)\subseteq A$ be a finitely
generated ideal. Then the standard opens $D_+(f_it)$ of
$\operatorname{Bl}_I(\operatorname{Spec}A)=\operatorname{Proj}\bigl(\bigoplus_{n\geq0}I^n\bigr)$
at the degree-one elements $f_it$, that is, the affine opens

$$
\operatorname{Spec}(A[I/f_i]),
$$

form a finite open cover of
$\operatorname{Bl}_I(\operatorname{Spec}A)$.

proof.text:
The opens $D_+(f_it)$ cover by
[lemma-nagata-rees-generators-cover-proj]. Replace each one by the
affine spectrum supplied by [prop-nagata-affine-blowup-chart]. The
compatibility of the open embeddings with the structure map is part of that
chart isomorphism.
